CustomField.description: Last day of the grant's period of performance, inclusive - a 10/01 to 09/30 award ends on 09/30. Drives Grant Length. Costs incurred after this date are not reimbursable, so it is the cut-off the reimbursement schedule is built against.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Last day of the period of performance, inclusive. A one-year 10/01 award ends 09/30, not 10/01.
CustomField.label: Grant End Date
